expects.reason: net8.0 is supported. AltCover instruments the built assemblies, runs the tests against them and reports sequence and branch-point coverage. It comes from NuGet; where NuGet is refused it exits 4 instead.

data.planted: three independent decisions giving 8 paths against 6 branches
data.expected: a path count that differs from the branch count
data.note: The C# core of this folder's fixtures is C# 5-compatible, so it is identical on all 13 families and what the tool measures cannot drift between them. The LanguageMarker class in each file is what pins the file to C# 12.0; it does not compile under C# 11.0. No project manifest is present, by design.
